title: Fix pagination drift in billing
why: Page boundaries shift when rows are inserted mid-scroll.

title: Retry failed webhook deliveries
why: Partners miss events when their endpoint blips for a second.
what: Add exponential backoff to src/webhooks/send.js, capped at five attempts. Run `npm test`; every test passes.

title: Cache search suggestions
why: Typing in the search box hits the database on every key.
what: Memoize suggestion lookups in src/search/suggest.js for sixty seconds. Run `npm test`; every test passes.

title: Alert on webhook retry exhaustion
why: Nobody hears about a partner that stopped receiving events.
what: Emit a metric when the fifth retry fails. Run `npm test`; every test passes.

title: Explain the export format in the README
why: Customers ask support what each CSV column means.
what: Add a column table to docs/export.md. Run `npm run lint:docs`; it reports no errors.
